_format.note: Run-long passives the protagonist accumulates. Effect keys read by engine: dealMult, takeMult, firstHitMult, lowHpDealMult, benchAlive, critChanceBonus, critMultBonus, healMult, reviveOnce, benchTickHeal, startStatusEnemy, reduceCursedSwap, capturedBonusXp, permHpFlat, startCharge (begins battle with N charge), energyBonus (extra energy turn 1).

pinned_page.name: Pinned page
pinned_page.voice: A page held to the wall by something that was not a pin.
pinned_page.desc: First attack each battle deals +50% damage.

bone_needle.name: Bone needle
bone_needle.voice: Sharper than the room. Older than the room.
bone_needle.desc: All damage you deal is increased by 10%.

wax_seal.name: Wax seal
wax_seal.voice: Sealed by a hand they will not name. The seal is warm.
wax_seal.desc: All damage you take is reduced by 15%.

letter_outside.name: Letter from outside
letter_outside.voice: It is addressed to me. The handwriting is mine.
letter_outside.desc: Once per run, when your last creature falls, it stands again at 60% hp.

misnamed_file.name: Misnamed file
misnamed_file.voice: I am not the patient on the page. I keep ~~reading~~ the page anyway.

morning_dose.name: Morning dose
morning_dose.voice: Taken before I knew it was a dose.

dark_thread.name: Dark thread
dark_thread.voice: It pulls from a place I cannot reach. I let it.
dark_thread.desc: When you are at 40% hp or below, your damage is +30%.

shared_breath.name: Shared breath
shared_breath.voice: What I breathe in, the bench breathes out.
shared_breath.desc: While your bench is conscious, you deal +15% damage.

salve_jar.name: Salve jar
salve_jar.voice: Smells faintly of [[8]]. The smell is unfamiliar.
salve_jar.desc: Healing you receive is increased by 35%.

long_gauze.name: Long gauze
long_gauze.voice: Far longer than the wound it was meant for.
long_gauze.desc: Your party gains +15 max hp permanently.

ash_in_pocket.name: Ash in pocket
ash_in_pocket.voice: Not from a fire I lit.
ash_in_pocket.desc: Bench creatures recover 10% hp at the start of each round.

borrowed_name.name: Borrowed name
borrowed_name.voice: I sign it on every door. None of them open.

older_admission.name: Older admission
older_admission.voice: Filed before the building stood here.
older_admission.desc: Captured patients arrive with +35% extra experience.

low_voice.name: Low voice
low_voice.voice: It speaks under the room. The room hears.
low_voice.desc: Enemy active begins each battle with Drained.

small_brick.name: Small brick
small_brick.voice: Pried from a wall I do not remember.
small_brick.desc: Enemy active begins each battle with Brittle.

second_wind.name: Second wind
second_wind.voice: A breath taken before the door is opened.
second_wind.desc: Begin each battle with +1 energy on the first round.
